pkgmetadata.longdescription: Claude Desktop is Anthropic's official desktop client for Claude.ai, bundling the Chat, Cowork, and Claude Code experiences (parallel sessions, visual diff review, an integrated terminal/editor, and live app preview) in one Electron application. Repackaged here from Anthropic's own Debian/Ubuntu .deb, since no upstream tarball or source build is offered.

use.flag: Install chrome-sandbox setuid root (upstream's own Debian package default), so Chromium's sandbox still works if unprivileged user namespaces are unavailable. Disabled by default, since most Gentoo kernels enable unprivileged userns and that alone is normally enough; enable this flag if your kernel config or an admin-set sysctl disables it instead.
